## Highlights


### Rewards Rate


3x points for every $1 spent on eligible Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines purchases


2x points for every $1 spent on eligible gas, EV charging station, shipping and local transit (including rideshare) purchases


1x point per $1 spent on all other purchases


10% rewards bonus on all points earned from card purchases if you have an eligible Bank of America® account


### Intro Offer


Limited time offer: Earn 70,000 bonus points and $99 Companion Fare (plus taxes and fees from $23) after you make $4,000 or more in purchases within the first 90 days of opening your account.

## Our Take


### Why We Like This Card


The Atmos™ Rewards Business Card is a high-value tool for small business owners who frequently fly Alaska Airlines or Hawaiian Airlines. With a low annual fee of $70 for the company plus $25 per card, it quickly pays for itself through core operational travel savings: you and up to six companions get a free checked bag ($70 round-trip value per person) and preferred boarding on every flight booked with the card. Meeting the $6,000 annual spend threshold unlocks an annual $99 Companion Fare, making it effortless to offset the annual fee on a single trip. You earn 3x points on Alaska and Hawaiian flight purchases, 2x points on common business expenses like gas, EV charging, shipping, and local transit (including rideshares), and 1 status point for every $3 spent toward earning Atmos elite status. Company owners with a Bank of America business checking or savings account also receive an automatic 10% rewards bonus on all card purchases.


### Other Benefits


- Earn another Companion Fare ($99 fare plus taxes and fees from $23) each account anniversary after spending $6,000 or more on purchases within the prior anniversary year.
- Free checked bag for any cardholder and up to 6 guests on the same reservation when you pay for your flight with your card – that’s a savings of $70 per person roundtrip!
- Preferred boarding for any cardholder when you pay for your Alaska Airlines or Hawaiian Airlines flight with an Atmos™ Rewards Business Card.
- Enjoy 20% back on Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines inflight purchases when you pay with your Atmos™ Rewards Business Card.
- Get $100 off an annual Alaska Lounge+ Membership purchased with your Atmos™ Rewards Business Card.
- No international transaction fees.
- Annual fee of $70 for the company and $25 per card.
